pictures.scene: Durer, The Seven Angels with the Trumpets — God enthroned in a sunburst above an altar while seven robed angels take their long trumpets and one blows a burning mountain down into the sea, then i saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven, seven angels with the seven final plagues
pictures.name: pd_durer_the_seven_angels_with_the_trumpets

pictures.scene: Van der Neer, A Fire at Night — a town burning at the waterside with the orange blaze and the smoke laid out across the still canal below it while small figures watch from the bank, with which the wrath of god is completed, and i saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire
pictures.name: pd_van_der_neer_nocturnal_fire

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, The Angels Playing Music — crowned angels in jewelled copes crowded around a pipe organ with a gilt harp and a viol held among them, beside which stood those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name, they were holding harps from god
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_the_angels_playing_music

pictures.scene: De Champaigne, Moses Presenting the Tablets of the Law — Moses in a blue mantle over gold brocade holding up the two written tablets with his staff across his arm and rays of light standing from his head, and they sang the song of god's servant moses and of the lamb, great and wonderful are your works, o lord god almighty
pictures.name: pd_de_champaigne_moses_presenting_the_tablets_of_the_law

pictures.scene: Van Eyck, God Enthroned from the Ghent Altarpiece — the Lord in a red mantle and a jewelled triple crown with a pearled orphrey and a great gold morse on His breast against a golden inscribed halo, just and true are your ways, o king of the nations, who will not fear you, o lord, and glorify your name
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_enthroned_ghent_altarpiece

pictures.scene: Repin, Religious Procession in Kursk Province — a huge crowd of every rank walking a dusty road behind gold banners and a carried icon with a priest in gold vestments at the right, for you alone are holy, all nations will come and worship before you
pictures.name: pd_repin_religious_procession_in_kursk_province

pictures.scene: Friedrich, Woman before the Rising Sun — a woman standing with her back to us on a stony rise, her arms opened to a wide gold sky breaking over the dark hills of the valley, for your righteous acts have been revealed, after this i looked
pictures.name: sunrise_over_the_valley

pictures.scene: Tissot, Moses and Aaron before the Ark — two figures kneeling with their hands raised before the golden ark and its winged cherubim inside the striped curtains of the tabernacle, and the temple, the tabernacle of the testimony, was opened in heaven, and out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues
pictures.name: pd_tissot_tabernacle

pictures.scene: Thayer, Angel — a young angel standing straight on with great white wings spread behind and a plain white linen dress gathered at the waist, dressed in clean and bright linen, and girded with golden sashes around their chests
pictures.name: pd_thayer_angel

pictures.scene: Petrus Christus, A Goldsmith in His Shop — a goldsmith in red holding a small balance over scattered gold coins while behind him the shelves carry rows of silver and gilt vessels, then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels, seven golden bowls full of the wrath of god
pictures.name: pd_christus_goldsmith

pictures.scene: Hubert Robert, The Fire of Rome — colonnades blazing beyond a great bridge arch with smoke filling the whole sky above the statue on the parapet while people carry what they can down the steps, who lives forever and ever, and the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of god and from his power
pictures.name: pd_robert_fire_in_rome

pictures.scene: Roberts, The Temple of Luxor — a vast carved temple front with a standing obelisk and seated colossi half buried in the sand while travellers and their camels rest outside the shut gateway, and no one could enter the temple, until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed
pictures.name: pd_roberts_temple_of_luxor

lines.text: Then I saw another great and marvelous sign in heaven:
seven angels with the seven final plagues,
with which the wrath of God is completed.
And I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire,
beside which stood those who had conquered the beast and its image and the number of its name.
They were holding harps from God,
and they sang the song of God's servant Moses and of the Lamb:
Great and wonderful are Your works, O Lord God Almighty!
Just and true are Your ways, O King of the nations!
Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name?
For You alone are holy.
All nations will come and worship before You,
for Your righteous acts have been revealed.
After this I looked,
and the temple, the tabernacle of the Testimony, was opened in heaven.
And out of the temple came the seven angels with the seven plagues,
dressed in clean and bright linen
and girded with golden sashes around their chests.
Then one of the four living creatures gave the seven angels
seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God,
who lives forever and ever.
And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from His power;
and no one could enter the temple
until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.
